input.content: Apply-guarded-by-terminal-status breaks failed-write retry (P1). When a save applies values then sets status="applied" BEFORE a receipt/commit step that can fail, guarding the apply with `if status == "pending"` means a retry (status already "applied") never re-applies. Combined with reading stored record["values"] captured at record creation instead of the freshly-submitted values, an edited-values retry silently keeps the old values — violating "retry with edited values; latest submitted values become active". Tests using identical retry values pass and hide this; add an edited-values retry test. Fix: on retry, re-apply the newly submitted values (provider is idempotent) rather than gating on a terminal status.
